candidate_program.name: tapered_resource_bonus
candidate_program.rationale: Adds a small saturated duration bonus relative to the larger actual resource gap while retaining count efficiency. Reach combines root resource attributes and local degree; arithmetic is constant size and degree updates remain charged. Gap occupancy is only approximate.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * duration / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
